description: 土石流潛勢溪流參考雨量站雨量資料 [landslides and debris flows and disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 農業部. 土石流潛勢溪流參考雨量站雨量資料，欄位包括County(潛勢溪流縣市)、Town(潛勢溪流鄉鎮)、Vill(潛勢溪流村里)、DebrisNO(潛勢溪流編號)、AlertValue(警戒值)、STID1(第一參考雨量站編號)、STName1(第一參考雨量站名稱)、STRT1(第一參考雨量站ETR2)、STID2(第二參考雨量站編號)、STN... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 農業部. Its tags are 生活安全及品質. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2024-11-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
